svg.title: Kafka controller failover: ZooKeeper mode vs KRaft mode
svg.desc: Side-by-side timeline showing every step of controller failover in old ZooKeeper mode (45s) vs new KRaft mode (under 5s), with components impacted at each step.

g.text: Controller broker JVM stops the world.
One broker wins the ZK race.
znode from ZK one by one.

svg.text: ← O(partitions) reads — this is why it took 37s

g.text: Could be GC, crash, or network.

svg.text: already replicated on every controller node.
Not re-electing partition leaders (they never changed). The bottleneck was
the new controller reading 800 ZooKeeper znodes sequentially, then sending
LeaderAndIsr RPCs to all brokers to re-confirm existing leaders.
